The famous Tripureswari Temple (one of the 51 Shakti Peethas) is at Matabari, Udaipur, Gomati district, ~55 km from Agartala - NOT in Belonia; it is already in the dataset under ids tripureshwari-temple-matabari-udaipur, tripura-sundari-temple-matabari-udaipur and tripura-sundari-temple-udaipur. Belonia's documented Kali shrines are the Yogmaya Kali Temple, Mahamaya Kalibari and Matai Kali Temple (Bura Kali Bari); none is named Tripureswari. Either the CSV town is wrong (row refers to the Matabari Shakti Peetha - then it is a duplicate), or the shrine is a small local Belonia shrine with no web footprint. Coordinates below are for Belonia town, not the shrine. Festivals, history, opening hours and image are all unverified - keep-or-verify decision needed.

town_description: Belonia is the headquarters town of South Tripura district near the Bangladesh border, set on the Muhuri river plain. It is known for Trishna Wildlife Sanctuary, Belonia Eco Park and local shrines such as the Yogmaya Kali Temple and Ram Thakur Smriti Mandir, and has its own railway station on the Agartala-Sabroom line.
